tagline.id: Saya membangun sistem web yang andal untuk kebutuhan bisnis, dari desain UI hingga server.
tagline.en: I build reliable web systems for business needs, from UI design all the way to the server.

about.id: Saya Full Stack Web Developer di PT Digital Optima Integra sejak 2022. Perjalanan saya dimulai sebagai UI/UX Designer, lalu Backend Developer, hingga kini Senior Full Stack Developer. Saya telah mengembangkan 4 sistem web internal perusahaan untuk pengelolaan data, maintenance, dan operasional, sekaligus menangani instalasi dan pemeliharaan server. Saya lulusan S1 Sistem Informasi Universitas Bina Sarana Informatika.
about.en: I'm a Full Stack Web Developer at PT Digital Optima Integra since 2022. I started as a UI/UX Designer, moved on to Backend Developer, and am now a Senior Full Stack Developer. I've built 4 internal web systems covering data management, maintenance, and operations, and I also handle server installation and maintenance. I hold a Bachelor's degree in Information Systems from Universitas Bina Sarana Informatika.
